items.title: Anthropic tells Claude to stop remaking video games
items.excerpt: Claude users are reporting that Anthropic's AI tool has been updated with a rule that bars it from remaking games.
items.rationale: A model maker now refuses to recreate existing games even when they are renamed. That changes what devs and modders can build with Claude, and it is Anthropic's first direct response to the clone flood on Steam.

items.title: Itch.io Reveals Just How Much AI Slop Is Flooding Gaming Storefronts
items.excerpt: The number of new game pages being created daily has doubled in the past two months
items.rationale: Itch.io's own data shows new game pages per day doubled in two months while downloads did not. These are the first hard platform numbers on AI slop beyond Steam, and they matter for anyone trying to get an indie release discovered.

items.title: Ramen launches Aura Autopilot, an Open-Source Autonomous Game Tester for Unreal Engine, Unity and Godot
items.excerpt: Ramen, maker of the multi-agent Aura assistant for Unity and Unreal, open-sourced Aura Autopilot, a self-improving playtesting agent that plays games in real time across Unreal, Unity and Godot and works with Claude Code, Codex or BYOK. Aura also adds Figma/Blender UI integration, text-to-character-motion and a reworked level blockout agent.
items.rationale: An open-source playtesting agent that devs can drop into Unreal, Unity or Godot today, with Claude Code, Codex or their own key: the most directly usable tool release in the pool.

items.title: 크래프톤 "AI 활용 방식 개선…API 비용 37% 줄여"
items.excerpt: 자체 'LLM 게이트웨이' 구축…AI 모델 98종 이상 제공·사용량 통합 관리. 전사 AI 활용 확대 속 비용 효율화…2027년 AI 에이전트 관리 체계 고도화. 크래프톤은 자체 개발한 LLM 게이트웨이로 사용 경로를 통합해 9월 API 비용을 전월 대비 약 37% 줄였다고 Games on AWS 2026에서 밝혔다.
items.rationale: A large publisher explains how it routes 98+ models through one in-house LLM gateway and cut API spend 37% in a month. It is a concrete operating pattern that other studios scaling AI can copy.

items.title: Helldivers 2 boss can "absolutely see" making a game parody of generative AI, but it would need to be "quirky" rather than "doom-laden"
items.excerpt: "We'd want to frame it in a quirky, fun way rather than a doom-laden one": Arrowhead's Johan Pilestedt mulls the potential for a game satire of generative AI.
items.rationale: The head of a major studio says he would make a game satirising generative AI. It adds a cultural angle to a lineup that is otherwise about tools and platforms: AI as subject matter, not only as a production tool.
